title: Smiling Boy Wrapped in Towel on Sandy Beach, 1960 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white snapshot with deckled edges dated July 1960, capturing a young boy sitting on a beach towel on the sand. Wrapped in a large white bath towel to dry off after swimming, he smiles directly at the camera. The bare legs of a standing adult accompany him on the left, alongside beach gear and sunbathers resting in the background, epitomizing mid-century American summer leisure.
